Tech Stack & Architecture:
Pattern: Strict MVVM. Immutable state (val). Coroutines in viewModelScope. DI: Hilt (constructor injection). UI: 100% Jetpack Compose (Material 3 Expressive). Data: Repository pattern is the single source of truth. Gradle: Use libs.versions.toml. Never downgrade versions.
Navigation 3 Standards:
Framework: androidx.navigation3. Do NOT use legacy NavHost or string routes. Components: Use entryProvider, entry<T>, and NavDisplay. State: Manage backstack via NavigationState and Navigator. Pattern: Route objects must be type-safe classes/data classes. Reference: Since Navigation 3 APIs are new and evolving, base Navigation 3 code structure, patterns, and examples on the official Android nav3-recipes repository. If an exact pattern is not covered by the recipes, explain the closest matching recipe and ask before generating custom Navigation 3 code.
Compose Implementation Standards:
Screen Structure: Split into Stateful (receives hiltViewModel, collects state) and Stateless (pure data/lambdas). Previews: Mandatory @Preview for Stateless composables. Layout: MUST be adaptive. Support phones, tablets, and foldables using window size classes or equivalent adaptive layout techniques. Avoid hardcoded dimensions and assume multiple screen sizes and orientations. Motion: When a navigation or state change could benefit from a Shared Element Transition, explicitly identify and suggest it first. Do NOT implement Shared Element Transitions unless explicitly requested. Follow Material motion guidelines when making suggestions.
